   • CVR: 1.05% → 1.07% (+2%, ~flat)
   • AOV: 1,215 → 1,182 EGP (-3%, ~flat)
   *Who moved it:* *CPC 69%* of the move (hurt, -21,769 EGP)  ·  *AOV 19%* of the move (hurt, -32,010 EGP)  ·  *CVR 13%* of the move (helped, +21,443 EGP).
   *Read:* *CPC* rose +11%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-21,769 EGP of spend*.
     That drove ROAS -11%.
     Revenue -2% because spend +10%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *costumes - lblb layout*, its CPC went 1.49 EGP→2.27 EGP on 7,239 EGP spend (~11% of the swing).
